findings.highlight: That means it's our sake as well.
findings.evidenceJa: 「かずさのためなんだよ？…それって、わたしたちのためじゃない」
findings.explanation: Setsuna insists the mission is for Kazusa and explicitly not for Haruki and Setsuna. The English says the exact opposite: that Kazusa's sake therefore equals their own sake.
findings.japanese:
「かずさのためなんだよ？
…それって、わたしたちのためじゃない」
findings.todokanai: "This is all for Kazusa's sake, you know? …That means it's our sake as well."

findings.highlight: Despite the fact that she willingly volunteered for the role
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が求めたこととは言え、雪菜に、ここまで残酷な役目を負わせることを。
findings.explanation: Haruki acknowledges that he himself asked for this and imposed the cruel role on Setsuna. The English shifts responsibility to Setsuna by saying she volunteered.
findings.japanese:
自分が求めたこととは言え、
雪菜に、ここまで残酷な役目を負わせることを。
findings.todokanai: Despite the fact that she willingly volunteered for the role, the fact remains that I'm imposing an extremely cruel task on her.

findings.highlight: I want to put my full concentration into thinking about what I can do for her.
findings.evidenceJa: 「今はかずさのことだけ考えていたい。かずさとぶつかることに集中していたいの」
findings.explanation: Setsuna wants to focus on colliding/clashing directly with Kazusa, not benevolently contemplating what she can do for her. The English removes the conflict she sees as necessary.
findings.japanese:
「今はかずさのことだけ考えていたい。
かずさとぶつかることに集中していたいの」
findings.todokanai: "I want to only think about Kazusa right now. I want to put my full concentration into thinking about what I can do for her."

findings.highlight: Still, maybe we will end up quarrelling a little.
findings.evidenceJa: 「そう、そんな感じ。まぁ面白くはないけど…でも、ちょっとだけほぐれてきたかな？」
findings.explanation: Setsuna says Haruki's awkward joking response is the right idea and asks whether he has loosened up a little. The English instead predicts that Setsuna and Kazusa may quarrel, changing both subject and event.
findings.japanese:
「そう、そんな感じ。まぁ面白くはないけど…
でも、ちょっとだけほぐれてきたかな？」
findings.todokanai: "Yeah, that's how it feels. Well, I suppose it wouldn't be particularly interesting this way… Still, maybe we will end up quarrelling a little."

findings.highlight: I decided to focus on getting better by familiarizing myself with the work
findings.evidenceJa: 「それでも、自分にできることは少なかったから、とにかくその場をうまく回すことだけ考えて、言われたこと一生懸命、とにかく笑顔でやってみた」
findings.explanation: Setsuna had little authority, so she focused on keeping the troubled worksite running smoothly, doing every instruction earnestly and smiling. The English turns crisis coordination into personal familiarization and improvement.
findings.japanese:
「それでも、自分にできることは少なかったから、
とにかくその場をうまく回すことだけ考えて、
言われたこと一生懸命、とにかく笑顔でやってみた」
findings.todokanai: "Even so, I couldn't really get very much done by myself, so I decided to focus on getting better by familiarizing myself with the work, and to follow my instructions with the utmost effort, or at the very least a smile."

findings.highlight: She's really, really done her best, all while she's trying to feel encouraged by words I'd said to deceive her, and all while knowing that there's a possibility that I might've betrayed her.
findings.evidenceJa:
そんな俺の誤魔化しでしかない言葉で自分を奮い立たせ、
俺に裏切られていたかも知れないその同じ時、
本当に、本当に、頑張って。
findings.explanation: Setsuna worked while Haruki might at that same time have been betraying her; 'knowing there was a possibility' makes her contemporaneously aware — The brutal coincidence between his words and possible betrayal remains.
findings.japanese:
そんな俺の誤魔化しでしかない言葉で自分を奮い立たせ、
俺に裏切られていたかも知れないその同じ時、
本当に、本当に、頑張って。
findings.todokanai: She's really, really done her best, all while she's trying to feel encouraged by words I'd said to deceive her, and all while knowing that there's a possibility that I might've betrayed her.

findings.highlight: the three of us will cross that final hurdle together
findings.evidenceJa: 「だから、その時は…三人でゴールしようね？」
findings.explanation: Within the explicit baton-and-anchor relay metaphor, Setsuna promises that all three will finish together. The English replaces the finish line with a 'final hurdle,' mixing sports metaphors and weakening the promise's endpoint.
findings.japanese: 「だから、その時は…三人でゴールしようね？」
findings.todokanai: "That's why when the time comes… the three of us will cross that final hurdle together, alright?"

findings.highlight: I suppose I need to think about how I'm going to spend the rest of my life making up for everything I've done to her.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は…これから一生かかって償わせてくれるだろうか。
findings.explanation: Haruki wonders whether Setsuna will allow him to spend the rest of his life atoning to her. The English turns her future permission into his private planning, removing Setsuna's agency over whether she accepts that life.
findings.japanese:
彼女は…
これから一生かかって償わせてくれるだろうか。
findings.todokanai: I suppose I need to think about how I'm going to spend the rest of my life making up for everything I've done to her.

findings.highlight: Perhaps I was never needed by her in the first place.
findings.evidenceJa: もう、多分俺を必要としないはずの彼女は。
findings.explanation: Haruki thinks the newly strong Setsuna probably no longer needs him. The English says she never needed him in the first place, erasing the relationship history and reversing the temporal claim.
findings.japanese: もう、多分俺を必要としないはずの彼女は。
findings.todokanai: Perhaps I was never needed by her in the first place.

findings.highlight: "I'm sorry, Haruki-kun… I'm so sorry! If only I'd kept close watch on her… no, it's because I've been so pushy with her that this ended up happening!"
findings.evidenceJa:
「ごめん春希くん…ごめんなさいっ！
わたしがついていながら…
ううん、わたしがついてたせいでこんなことにっ」
findings.explanation: Setsuna corrects 'despite being with her' to 'because I was with her'; the English changes this into insufficient watchfulness versus pushiness — Her self-blame for worsening Kazusa's state remains.
findings.japanese:
「ごめん春希くん…ごめんなさいっ！
わたしがついていながら…
ううん、わたしがついてたせいでこんなことにっ」
findings.todokanai: "I'm sorry, Haruki-kun… I'm so sorry! If only I'd kept close watch on her… no, it's because I've been so pushy with her that this ended up happening!"

findings.highlight: No reason, really, I just didn't want you to bother me, Setsuna.
findings.evidenceJa: 「別に、雪菜がウザくなっただけじゃないよ」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says it is not merely that Setsuna became annoying; she also missed the piano. The English says annoyance is the sole reason, reversing the setup for her more vulnerable admission.
findings.japanese: 「別に、雪菜がウザくなっただけじゃないよ」
findings.todokanai: "No reason, really, I just didn't want you to bother me, Setsuna."

findings.highlight: It's amazing anyone can bear him… that coward.
findings.evidenceJa: 「本当、やられちゃうよね…あの卑怯者」
findings.explanation: Setsuna quietly agrees that the underhanded Haruki really gets/defeats you—he makes both women succumb to him. The English says it is remarkable anyone can tolerate him, replacing rueful shared romantic defeat with repulsion.
findings.japanese: 「本当、やられちゃうよね…あの卑怯者」
findings.todokanai: "It's amazing anyone can bear him… that coward."
